host: Two host checks (ci): test/identity.mjs compares the package with the sha256-pinned zig source tarball, and test/host-build.mjs builds wasi-libc from the package's sources with the sha256-pinned host zig 0.16.0 and runs a program linked against it under node:wasi. A source package has no commands of its own. The in-kernel path (wasi-zig building wasi-libc from these sources for a non-baseline CPU) takes about 7 min on a laptop and ran past 45 min on the CI runner, so it isn't a cert spec (cert/NEGATIVE.md).
checklist: identity (test/identity.mjs): the package's lib/libc is file for file (sha256) zig-0.16.0.tar.xz's lib/libc/wasi and lib/libc/musl, downloaded and checked against the recipe's sha256, and LICENSE is Zig's

a complete wasi-libc (test/host-build.mjs): host zig 0.16.0 (ziglang.org, the recipe's per-host sha256) with zig's lib/ and this package's libc/wasi and libc/musl builds wasi-libc for -target wasm32-wasi -mcpu=generic+simd128 -O2, links a malloc/strcpy/printf program that imports only wasi_snapshot_preview1, and the program prints `simd128 libc 12 argc=2` under node:wasi
